dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: Proto-Boss. Do you want to talk about the cannon... or were you hoping to ask about Frejus?

choices.text: You don't seem very interested in the cannon...

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Hah. You've seen right through me...

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: To be honest, I'm starting to regret helping Frejus keep up his whole "genius" act.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: His ambition keeps growing unchecked. It's enough that he made an official military version of his cannon, but rushing out here to this dangerous place to test it...

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: If it wasn't for the fact that Miss Marine happened to be here already, he could've been in real danger.

choices.text: He's got you to protect him, too.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Well, I set up a minefield that only the monsters can trigger to the cannon's rear. Even if the cannon doesn't get them all, there's no way they'll escape the ruins.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: If something goes wrong with the minefield, I've also got my musket — more than enough to take out the luckier or more cunning ones.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: I've been training hard ever since the last time I needed rescuing. I bet my shooting skills can even match Turenna's now.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Besides, the cannon's been doing a very good job up until now.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: In fact, after the last field test received such a positive response, Frejus's endeavors haven't resulted in a single painful defeat.

choices.text: What if he does fail spectacularly?

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: I've wondered what I should do if everyone loses interest again and his inventions no longer attract attention...

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: "Don't worry about it. It doesn't matter if you're not a genius."

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Is that how I should comfort him? It seems a little cruel.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Self-esteem is important. I don't want anyone to make him think less of himself. So, I have to help him keep up the act.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: If those engineers he's been talking to abandon him, I'll recruit a few of the experts who keep sending me invites to come and play their parts.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: I've stopped caring all too much if it's interesting or not. I just... can't let this pretense end too quickly.

choices.text: What if he falls on hard times?
You don't seem afraid of those monsters either.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Alright, you get down to business. I'll be here with Frejus, so come find me if you need me.

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: On top of those mechanical defenders, we'll also need maintenance meks to keep the cannon in working order and logistics meks to keep it supplied with ammunition and parts...

dialogues.speaker: Frejus
dialogues.text: It looks like we've got our work cut out for us — the design blueprints alone will take the best part of a year to draw up!

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: No problem, just take your time. There's no need to stay up all night working on this either, we've got all the time in the world...
